description: Manage automated recurring job posting subscriptions to monitor target companies or natural language queries for active hiring signals and discover decision makers. Actions: - 'create': Create a subscription. Supports query-driven mode ('query', 'limit') or company-driven mode ('companies', 'departments', 'jobTitles'). Set cadence with 'frequencyDays' (7-30). - 'get': Retrieve a subscription by 'subscriptionId', including latest hiring findings and decision makers. - 'update': Update target companies, query, departments, cadence, webhookUrl, or status ('active'/'paused') by 'subscriptionId'. - 'list': List all job posting subscriptions. - 'delete': Cancel and permanently delete a subscription by 'subscriptionId'.

addCompanies.description: Append new companies to the existing monitored list in 'update'.

companies.description: Array of up to 100 companies to monitor (for company-driven mode, or full replacement in 'update').

items.description: Company to monitor for job postings.

companyWebsite.description: Official company website domain or URL (e.g. 'stripe.com'). Recommended for accurate matching.

departments.description: Canonical department names to find employees or insights for. Must be chosen from the enum values. CONCEPTUAL MAPPING: Map broad business functions to the closest canonical enum options: - 'Commercial', 'GTM', 'Go-to-market' -> ['Sales', 'Marketing']; - 'Revenue', 'BizDev' -> ['Sales', 'Finance & Accounting']; - 'Tech', 'Software', 'Developers' -> ['Engineering and Technical', 'Information Technology']; - 'AI', 'ML', 'Data Science' -> ['Data & Analytics', 'Engineering and Technical']; - 'People', 'Talent', 'Recruiting' -> ['Human Resources']; - 'Leadership', 'Management' -> ['C-Suite', 'CEO', 'COO']; - 'Cybersecurity', 'InfoSec' -> ['Security', 'Information Technology']; - 'Supply Chain' -> ['Operations', 'Logistics']. For bespoke or custom role titles (e.g. 'RevOps', 'DevRel', 'Full Stack Engineer'), use jobTitles instead. SUBSCRIPTION LIMITS: Max 5 departments and max 10 job titles per subscription.

frequencyDays.description: Cadence in days between automated checks (7 to 30, default 7).

limit.description: Maximum number of job postings to scan per run for query-driven mode (min 1, max 100, default 30).

name.description: A readable name for this subscription (for 'create' or 'update').

query.description: Natural language search query string for query-driven mode (e.g. 'active marketing or sales jobs posted by companies with 20-1000 employees in fmcg in the US'). Mutually exclusive with 'companies'.

removeCompanyWebsites.description: List of company website domains to remove in 'update'.

runImmediately.description: Whether to immediately start the first run upon creation (default: true).

status.description: Change subscription status: 'active' to run on schedule, 'paused' to halt (for 'update').

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL where findings will be POSTed on each completed run.

name: precept_job_posting_subscriptions

outputSchema.description: Result of job posting subscription operations (create, get, update, list, delete)

latestResult.description: Most recently discovered job postings and decision makers

subscription.description: Detailed subscription configuration and latest run stats

subscriptions.description: List of all job posting subscriptions (when action is 'list')
